status_vocabulary.CLOSED: implemented and evidenced in this archive; no external environment needed for its Definition of Done
status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_LOCAL: in-archive implementation and tests done; Definition of Done still needs an external environment/exercise
status_vocabulary.OWNER_ACTION: needs a decision or asset only the owner can provide
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: needs an external dependency, lab or estate not present

components.name: pk_core runtime package
components.observed_gap: required by `component.py` and `contract.py`; without it, the 100-item component assessment and gate cannot execute.
components.blocker: pk_core is not available in this environment: startup compatibility assertion, adapter boundary, lazy import and negative fixtures (absent/old/new-major/missing submodules) are implemented and tested, but the 100-item assessment, run/gate/verify and a digest pin need the real package.

components.name: INV-11 Interface contract language
components.observed_gap: required for typed signature/version compatibility checks. Without INV-11, `assess_interfaces()` intentionally reports a partial result.
components.blocker: INV-11 not installed. Local typed layer + the full breaking/additive fixture set are implemented and enforced in admission in addition to name closure; INV-11 remains the authority and is required for closure.

components.name: INV-27 Unikernel execution
components.observed_gap: declared upstream dependency supplying a verified sealed host image; implementation/evidence is not included here.
components.blocker: INV-27 not available. Sealed-image attestation contract, adapter with timeout/retry/breaker and a labelled fault-injecting test double exist; a real INV-27 integration run is required.

components.name: INV-44 Wasm hardening system
components.observed_gap: declared upstream dependency supplying hardened Wasm runtime configuration; implementation/evidence is not included here.
components.blocker: INV-44 not available. Hardened-module attestation contract + test double exist; real INV-44 integration run required.

components.name: PLN-04 Execution plane
components.observed_gap: declared downstream admission plane; not included here.
components.blocker: PLN-04 not available. verify_record() is the consumer contract and ExecutionPlaneTestDouble proves unsigned records are refused; PLN-04 must adopt it.

components.name: INV-30 Capability hardware sandbox
components.observed_gap: optional peer/third isolation layer; not included here.
components.blocker: INV-30 (optional) not available; schema reserves the 'hardware-capability' layer and policy.required_layers=3 already refuses without it. Applicability decision is the owner's.

components.name: MASTER.md
components.observed_gap: explicitly referenced by the prior README as containing the 100 per-item master prompt/workflow documents, but absent from the archive.
components.blocker: MASTER.md (the 100 per-item master prompt/workflow documents) is the owner's source material and is not in the archive; it cannot be reconstructed without inventing content. Owner to supply.
